title: Mit szólsz hozzá? Making a Suggestion

sections.title: Floating an idea
sections.content: Mit szólsz hozzá? ("What do you say to it? / What do you think?") is a natural way to float a suggestion and ask for a reaction. It's built from szól ("to say, to speak") plus hozzá ("to it") — the same -hoz/-hez/-höz you met in Unit 7, now attached to a pronoun instead of a place. Pair it with javasol ("to suggest") to make the proposal itself.

sections.title: Suggesting and reacting
rows: What do you say to it? / What do you think?

items.spanish: Javaslok egy bulit szombaton. Mit szólsz hozzá?
items.english: I suggest a party on Saturday. What do you think?
Do you feel like joining us?

sections.content: hozzá, hozzám, hozzád, hozzánk are all -hoz/-hez/-höz forms of personal pronouns, the same pattern you already know for "toward" a place — here it's simply reused for reacting to an idea instead of walking toward somewhere.
